summary: Ochoco NF lookout 17 miles NE of Prineville: a 1932 crow's nest, a 1935 25-foot wooden L-5 tower, gone by 1968; no source describes the site now.

facts.design: 25-foot wooden tower, L-5 design (1935), replacing a 1932 crow's nest
facts.status_note: Tower gone by 1968 per the registry; firelookout.com also gives 1968

notes_for_editor: Three sources agree on the 1932 crow's nest, the 1935 tower and the gone-by-1968 date. Only the L-5 design and 25-foot height come from firelookout.com alone (7.6 m is the 25-foot conversion). Staffing and 1928-1932 items come from a volunteer history page that quotes newspapers; they are not checked against the newspapers. The page's undated 1919 fire-finder paragraph is about the lookout service in general and is left out. The WebSearch hit on a Bend Bulletin article and a 1913 Ochoco history was not read and is not used. Nothing describes the site today; a visit would need a Prineville or Ochoco NF contact.
